scene_cards.dramatic_objective: Isolate and lock the anomalous Beacon 9 carrier wave on the observatory azimuth array
scene_cards.active_obstacle: Geomagnetic sleet storm and encrypted phase drift
scene_cards.character_stakes: Missing the transmission window permanently erases the coordinates

scene_cards.dramatic_objective: Descend into the Sub-Level 4 Cryogenic Relay Vault and insert the Chrono-Compass
scene_cards.active_obstacle: Venting cryogenic nitrogen mist and Koren's concealed override protocol
scene_cards.character_stakes: Exposure of the Aether Directorate's sabotage of Beacon 9

scene_cards.dramatic_objective: Transmit the decrypted Jovian coordinates before the vault bulkhead seals
scene_cards.active_obstacle: Automated containment purge and fracturing waveguide
scene_cards.character_stakes: Survival of the Helios Watch crew and preservation of the signal proof
